verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents Guarded rollouts, which 'progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions.' Its metric-type docs cover custom and numeric metrics that can serve as guardrails, and progressive rollouts and change-history rollback round out the release-safety tooling. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that a detected regression triggers an automatic rollback (the evidence covers only metric monitoring for regressions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of guarded rollouts in practice.
